title: Nonaqueous electrolyte solution, nonaqueous secondary battery, battery pack, and hybrid system
abstract: An object is to provide a non-aqueous electrolyte solution, a non-aqueous secondary battery, a battery pack, and a hybrid system that can improve desired battery performance using acetonitrile in particular. The non-aqueous electrolyte solution of the present invention is characterized by containing acetonitrile, a lithium salt, and a cyclic acid anhydride. The non-aqueous secondary battery of the present invention includes: a positive electrode having a positive electrode active material layer on one or both surfaces of a current collector; a negative electrode having a negative electrode active material layer on one or both surfaces of the current collector; An aqueous electrolyte solution comprising acetonitrile and a lithium salt in the non-aqueous electrolyte solution, and a capacity calculated by dividing the 5C discharge capacity by the 1C discharge capacity after the nonaqueous secondary battery is stored in a test at 85°C for 4 hours The maintenance rate is above 70%. In addition, the aforementioned non-aqueous secondary battery is characterized in that the ionic conductivity at 0° C. after a 4-hour storage test at 85° C. is 10 mS/cm or more.
